name: The Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Morgan Stanley

localized_names.en: The Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Morgan Stanley

apr.notes: APR terms not published on the official pages reviewed; see the Card application terms and disclosures for current Pay Over Time and Cash Advance APRs.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee (standard on The Platinum Card).

credit_required.notes: Available only to clients who maintain an eligible Morgan Stanley Smith Barney LLC brokerage account. American Express may cancel the Card Account if an eligible Morgan Stanley brokerage account is not maintained.

base_rate.description: 1x point per dollar on other eligible purchases

categories.label: Flights booked directly with airlines or through Amex Travel
Prepaid hotels booked through Amex Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points can be transferred to airline/hotel partners or redeemed through Membership Rewards. Morgan Stanley-specific redemption/earn details beyond the standard Platinum structure were not published on the official pages reviewed.

benefits.title: $895 Annual Engagement Bonus
benefits.description: Basic Card Members with a Morgan Stanley Platinum CashPlus Brokerage Account receive an $895 Annual Engagement Bonus, deposited into the Platinum CashPlus account after Card Account opening and each year at Card renewal (or by meeting the Debit Card Use Threshold). Eligibility and CashPlus account required.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.description: Complimentary access to the Global Lounge Collection, including Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass Select, Delta Sky Club (when flying Delta), Plaza Premium, and Escape Lounges. Enrollment may be required.

benefits.title: $600 Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 back semi-annually ($600/year) on select prepaid hotel bookings through Amex Travel. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $200 Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Select one qualifying airline and receive up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year for incidental fees such as checked bags and in-flight refreshments. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $200 Uber Cash
benefits.description: Up to $200 in Uber Cash per year for U.S. rides and Uber Eats orders. Must add the eligible Card to the Uber account.

benefits.title: $300 Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.description: Up to $25 in statement credits each month (up to $300/year) on eligible purchases at Disney+, ESPN streaming, Hulu, and other participating services. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $219 CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.description: Up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year for a CLEAR+ Membership paid with the Card. Enrollment required.

lounge_access.program: Global Lounge Collection (Centurion, Priority Pass Select, Delta Sky Club, Plaza Premium, Escape Lounges)
lounge_access.notes: Complimentary access via the Global Lounge Collection.

notes: The Platinum Card from American Express Exclusively for Morgan Stanley, issued by American Express National Bank; available only to eligible Morgan Stanley Smith Barney brokerage clients. Annual fee $895, verified 2026-07-25 against the Amex application listing and Morgan Stanley CashPlus disclosures. The card's headline Morgan Stanley perk is a recurring $895 Annual Engagement Bonus for Platinum CashPlus clients (current disclosure footnote; an older $695 figure appears only in legacy marketing video content). No standalone Membership Rewards welcome offer was published on the official pages reviewed (signup_bonus null). APR not published on the reviewed pages; standard Platinum earn structure (5x flights/prepaid hotels, 1x base) reflected. network_tier is none for Amex.
